 "data": "flowchart TB
 A[\"Browse++ Custom C++ Browser Engine\"]:::title

 subgraph UI[\"UI & Tab Management Layer\"]
 direction TB
 T[\"Tab Manager<br/>Active tabs, instances, navigation\"]:::ui
 G[\"Shell GUI<br/>Bookmarks, history, themes, context menu\"]:::ui
 U[\"URL Input\"]:::input
 U -->|\"URL request\"| T
 G -.->|\"UI actions\"| T
 end

 subgraph IO[\"Network & I/O Layer\"]
 direction LR
 N[\"HTTP/HTTPS<br/>Network Handler\"]:::io
 F[\"Local File<br/>Loader\"]:::io
 end

 subgraph PARSE[\"Parsing Layer\"]
 direction LR
 H[\"HTML Parser\"]:::parse
 C[\"CSS Parser<br/>Stylesheets & inline styles\"]:::parse
 end

 subgraph DOC[\"Document Tree Layer\"]
 direction LR
 D[\"DOM Tree Handler\"]:::doc
 O[\"CSS DOM Tree<br/>(CSSOM)\"]:::doc
 end

 subgraph RENDER[\"Layout & SDL3 Rendering Pipeline\"]
 direction TB
 L[\"Layout Engine<br/>Combines DOM + CSSOM<br/>Text positioning, dimensions, box layout\"]:::layout
 LT[\"Layout Tree<br/>Geometry & styling\"]:::layout
 S[\"SDL3 Rendering Engine<br/>Graphics & text drawing\"]:::render
 P[\"Pixels on Screen<br/>Active Tab / UI\"]:::output
 end

 T -->|\"HTTP/HTTPS request\"| N
 T -->|\"Local path request\"| F
 N -->|\"Raw HTML/CSS strings\"| H
 N -->|\"Raw stylesheet data\"| C
 F -->|\"Raw file strings\"| H
 F -->|\"Raw stylesheet data\"| C
 H -->|\"DOM nodes\"| D

 D -->|\"Document structure\"| L

 L -->|\"Positioned boxes & styles\"| LT
 LT -->|\"Geometry and paint data\"| S
 S -->|\"Rendered pixels\"| P
 P -->|\"Displayed in active tab\"| T
